name: Smooth Wipe
description: A wide soft-edged wipe that sweeps across the frame from one side. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: direction
params.description: Where the second clip comes from: 0 = right to left (xfade smoothleft), 1 = left to right (smoothright), 2 = bottom to top (smoothup), 3 = top to bottom (smoothdown)
